title: Built a free chart analysis platform with an artificial intelligence assistant that draws on your chart while u reflect & prompt.
author: Vegetable_Ferret2328
selftext:
Hey everyone. I have spent the last several months building something I wish existed when I first started trading. It is called TradingWithYou, a chart analysis platform that automatically detects support and resistance zones on live market data, runs a statistical check on each setup against historical replay data before you act on it, and includes an artificial intelligence assistant you can actually talk to that will draw levels, add indicators, or run a backtest on your own chart while you watch.  
[https://tradingwithyou.com](https://tradingwithyou.com/)  
That is the waitlist if you want to take a look before I finish explaining. No credit card required, just a spot in line.  
Here is the part that matters most if you have been burned by other artificial intelligence trading tools before. This platform never connects to your broker and never places a trade for you. It is analysis only. You still make every decision yourself with your own broker. I built it that way on purpose. I do not trust a black box trading bot with my own money, and I figured most people here feel the same.  
A few things set it apart from just another charting application. You can write your own indicators and publish them to a shared library instead of waiting on someone else's roadmap. The artificial intelligence assistant runs through your own Claude account rather than ours, so nothing from your setup gets uploaded anywhere. And if you need stocks, cryptocurrency, or index coverage beyond the native foreign exchange and metals engine, you can switch to a built-in TradingView view or connect your own Alpaca account directly.  
Everyone who joins before launch gets founding member status, early access ahead of the general public, a real say in what gets built next through our Telegram group, and a direct line to me while this is still a small, hands-on project.  
Launch is coming soon. I am happy to answer anything in the comments, and I am genuinely looking for feedback from people who actually trade.

comments.author: leroylabs
comments.body: How do you prevent the automatically detected support and resistance zones from using future bars during historical replay? I’d show users the zone exactly as it existed at each decision timestamp, including when it was first confirmed, then report results after spread and latency rather than simply checking today’s zones against old prices. Also, “your own Claude account” does not necessarily mean nothing is uploaded: are chart data and prompts sent directly to Anthropic, and can the assistant access Alpaca credentials or only returned market data?

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: I'd poke at the replay check. if the zones get detected with the full history in view, the replay already knows where price turned and every zone tests well. does it redraw them bar by bar during replay?

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Keeping it analysis-only and making the assistant run through the user's own account is a clear way to build trust. The part I'd want to see is the statistical check on each zone: how many past zones it was run on, how often price actually reacted compared with randomly placed levels on the same charts, and whether that holds on a period it wasn't tuned on. Support and resistance zones are drawn after the fact so easily that this comparison is what tells people whether the tool adds anything. Cymetica's Backtest Labs is one place to see how strategy results get compared against a benchmark.
